sn45.34:3.1: These verses also occur in the context of the seven awakening factors ([sn46.17:2.1]()), the tenfold path ([an10.117:2.1](), [an10.118:3.1]()), the ten ways of skillful deeds ([an10.169:3.1](), [an10.170:2.1]()), and as independent verses ([dhp85]()–89).
sn45.34:7.2: For “awakening factors” the Pali has _sambodhiyaṅga_, which is a different spelling of _sambojjhaṅga_, familiar from the “seven awakening factors”. Since these verses are used with several different expositions of the path, it seems the word is used in the general sense of factors leading to awakening, rather than specifically the group of seven.
